title: Snoring treatment
what: The doctor finds where the airflow is blocked in your throat and nose and suggests treatment. Often it is a small procedure on the soft palate or in the nose, with local numbing.
why: When loud snoring disturbs you and your family, especially if your breathing stops during sleep.
duration: the exam usually takes 30 minutes; a procedure usually takes 20 to 40 minutes, and you go home the same day
tell_doctor: If your breathing stops during sleep. Ask your family
High blood pressure, heart disease, or diabetes
Allergy to painkillers or numbing medicine

prepare.title: Sleep
prepare.text: Your doctor may first send you for a sleep study to rule out pauses in breathing. This matters for choosing treatment.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take, and they will decide.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Before a procedure, usually a light meal 1 to 2 hours before. Check with the clinic.

bring: Sleep study results, if you have them
steps: The doctor examines your nose, throat, and soft palate
Sometimes a thin camera is passed through the nose
If a procedure is needed, the throat or nose is numbed with a spray and a shot
Using a thin probe, the doctor stiffens and shrinks the soft palate or nasal turbinates
After the procedure, you are watched briefly and sent home
feel: For a few days afterward, your throat hurts, like a sore throat
after: Soft, warm food for a few days, nothing spicy or hot
The effect usually shows in a few weeks. Sometimes a repeat procedure is needed
Losing weight and avoiding alcohol at night also reduce snoring
red_flags: Bleeding from the throat that will not stop: call emergency services
Trouble breathing, or cannot swallow even water: call emergency services

faq.a: Snoring alone is usually not dangerous. But if your breathing stops during sleep, it needs treatment. Tell your doctor.

faq.q: Will the snoring go away for good?
faq.a: For many people, snoring gets quieter or stops. Sometimes it comes back over time.

reminders.text: Snoring treatment tomorrow. Bring your sleep study results, if you have them, and your medicine list.
